status: Exploratory protocol written after source/schema inspection and before new model evaluation
selection: Choose model/configuration by five-fold StratifiedGroupKFold accuracy on published training partition, grouping identical full symptom-value vectors. Fit vectorizer within each fold. Published test used only for evaluation.
views: all values excluding exact label-named fields
duplicates: Report test excluding exact training fact vectors; also refit after deduplicating training vectors with labels. Do not silently discard contradictory labels.
questionnaires: All-recorded means all available explicit and implicit findings, not an active-questioning performance estimate. 0/1/2 are separate recorded states; missing is unobserved.
post_run_preprocessing_correction: During delivery verification, MZ-10 had conflicting explicit/implicit values in 371 train and 91 test cases. Initial implicit-precedence outputs archived; main pipeline corrected to explicit precedence, matching author utils.filter_duplicate. No model configurations or selection rules changed; affected results rerun.
mcq: Use local MedQA train/dev/test and MedMCQA train/validation. TF-IDF retrieves labeled training questions; retrieved answer texts score current options by character TF-IDF similarity. k in [1,5,20], selected using MedQA dev or deterministic MedMCQA training holdout. Include lexical-only and majority-position baselines. No explanations or test labels in inputs.
gpt6: No authenticated API credential available in current process; no matched GPT-6 results will be claimed. Export label-free prompts and separate evaluation labels for later identical-input comparison.
novelty: Distinguish new empirical DDXPlus audit results from established knowledge-based diagnosis methods. Search failure is not proof of priority.
